questions.question: Consider the causal continuous-time LTI system with transfer function $H(s)=\frac{\prod_{i=1}^{M}(s-b_i)}{\prod_{i=1}^{N}(s-a_i)}$, $a_i,b_i\in\mathbb{R}$. It is discretized by mapping poles and zeros as $p_i=g(a_iT_s)$, $z_i=g(b_iT_s)$, where $T_s$ is the sampling time and $g(x)=\frac{1-e^{-x}}{1+e^{-x}}$, giving $W(z)=\frac{\prod_{i=1}^{M}(z-z_i)}{\prod_{i=1}^{N}(z-p_i)}$. Select the correct statement.

options.A: The resulting discretized system is always stable
options.B: It is not possible to determine the stability of the system with the given information
options.C: None of the other statements is correct
options.D: If the continuous-time system is stable, then the discretized system is unstable
options.E: If the continuous-time system is unstable, then the discretized system is unstable
